checks.message: Associations run automatically on a schedule — verify the document and targets are correct
checks.context: A State Manager association applies an SSM document to target instances on a recurring schedule. A misconfigured association can repeatedly run unintended commands across your fleet.

checks.message: Send-command executes arbitrary commands on target instances. Verify the document and targets
checks.context: SSM Run Command can execute shell commands as root/administrator on any managed instance. A wrong target filter can run commands on production instances. Verify the instance IDs or tags carefully.

checks.message: No execution timeout specified. Command may run indefinitely
checks.context: Without a timeout, a hung or runaway command continues executing with no automatic termination. Set a timeout to prevent indefinite execution on managed instances.

checks.message: Terminating a session immediately disconnects the user
checks.context: If a user is performing critical work through the session, terminating it can leave operations incomplete. Session Manager logs the session history for audit.
